entities.summary: Ruphin Fortunat Zafisambo Dimbisoa is a Malagasy general who served as the 29th prime minister of Madagascar in 2025. Having served in the role for two weeks, he is the shortest-serving prime minister in Malagasy history. Zafisambo was also the last prime minister to serve under the presidency of Andry Rajoelina, who was deposed in a 2025 coup.
